name: Zebstrika
description: Zebstrika, the Thunderbolt Pokémon, and the evolved form of Blitzle. An Electric type.
pokedex_entries: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.
This ill-tempered Pokémon is dangerous because when it's angry, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.
When this ill-tempered Pokémon runs wild, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.
